nom: Personal Day Trust Me on This Hypochlorous Acid Gel

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with eczema, rosacea, or MCAS-related reactivity, report the gel calms redness and irritation without stinging, though one sensitive/rosacea-prone user reports a flare-up and a strong chemical smell.
segments.mature: A 46-year-old reviewer with sensitive, rosacea- and rash-prone skin keeps it as an emergency spot treatment for pimples and rosacea plaques, calling it expensive but worth keeping on hand.
segments.dry: One reviewer notes the gel is drying around healing breakout areas, making makeup application harder, while another with a dry scaly forehead spot reports it finally improved after other products failed.

concerns.dehydration: A few reviewers describe mild drying or tightness after use, especially around healing breakouts, though most describe the gel as hydrating or non-drying and pair it with a moisturizer afterward.
concerns.redness: Numerous reviewers report the gel calms redness, irritation, and inflammation quickly, often overnight; one reviewer with rosacea reports the opposite, a flare-up with heat and redness after application.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema and psoriasis describe faster healing and reduced itchiness on flare-ups, including one describing visible improvement within a day on a psoriasis patch.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report dark spots, acne marks, and post-picking marks fading faster and scars/pigmentation looking less evident with regular use.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority describe blemishes and pimples healing faster, surfacing and clearing within 24-48 hours, and reduced frequency of new breakouts; a small number report no meaningful change or packaging issues that limited use before seeing results.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer applies it specifically to oily zones (nose, chin, hairline) and reports breakouts there clearing and staying clear.

aspects.libelle: Gel form preferred over spray for precision

extraits.titre: Triggered a rosacea flare up and smells AWFUL
extraits.texte: This triggered a rosacea flareup for me. I used it and then about 20 minutes later, my cheeks were bright red and hot and didn't go back down until the next morning. So if you have sensitive skin or rosacea, you might want to pass. The other thing is that it smells TERRIBLE. It smells exactly like pool chemicals (because it actually is an industrial disinfectant). The smell does fade a few minutes after you put it on but wow, it is very strong and unpleasant right out of the bottle.

For my acne prone, sensitive skin, this does the tricking at calming my redness and irritation from my breakouts and my acne treatments! Most brands have this acid combo in a spray, but I really like using the gel because I'm not wasting product spraying it in the air. One bottle lasts a long time too!

extraits.titre: Amazing for post extractions and hormonal breakouts!!!
extraits.texte: I got this product during the 21 days of beauty sale, I decided to give it a go because ive been wanting to try this brand and it was 50% off. I dermaplane and do blackhead extractions on myself bi weekly (safely and I've done ample research). I always use the good molecules hypochlorus acid spray and love that and this seemed to be an adjacent product. Ive been using it on my breakouts and problem areas almost daily since I got it and WOW!! It is like a magic eraser for my face. I have VERY sensitive skin and eczema and this did not irritate my skin whatsoever. It felt so amazing after extractions and soothed the redness around my blemishes. I also used it to soothe a sunburn on my cheeks and it worked well for that as well! Highly recommend this product! I read some reviews saying there were issues with the packaging, I personally did not have any issues with the packaging on the product I bought. I feel sad for those who had a bad experience with this product but everyone's skin is different!

I've been using the Trust Me on This Hypochlorous Acid Gel for almost two months, and it has completely changed my skin. I struggle with acne and sensitivity, and since adding this into my routine, my skin hardly breaks out anymore. I actually bought the whole skincare line, but the gel is hands-down my favorite. It made the biggest difference in calming inflammation and healing breakouts faster. It's super lightweight, absorbs quickly, and never leaves my skin feeling sticky or greasy. Just clean, calm, and refreshed. If you're dealing with breakouts or skin that gets easily irritated, this is 100% worth trying. It's become my go-to for keeping my skin clear and balanced.

I'm in my early 30s and starting to experience more small uneven textured bumps that not even exfolation was helping. I bonded with an Ulta worker about it and she swore by this. I figured I'd give it a go since I've tried so many other products to no avail and this was in my price point. YALL. When I tell you I noticed a difference within 2 days, WITHOUT any purging!! I have sensitive skin and have experienced severe eczema that occasionally flares up with some new products, but I've been using this for about 2 weeks without any issue. My skin looks and feels night and day compared to 2 weeks ago. My forehead now has that glassy shine instead of looking dull and bumpy. This will absolutely stay in my essentials line up so long as the formula stays the same!

extraits.titre: Must for your sensitive, problem skin kit.
extraits.texte: I am 46 with super sensitive acne, rosacea, a rash prone skin. This is a must have for your emergency spot kit for when you have a big pimple, rosacea plaque, or eczema type patch that you want to go away overnight. I can use this along with the new Vani watery pump lotion and the Paula salicylic spray meant for backs on my face when I want to clear acne from my skin quickly and gracefully ASAP.. IKYK. Expensive, but must keep on hand. Probably goes bad in 3 mos from what I read about HA? Check on it.

extraits.titre: Lightweight & Absorbing, But a Tad Drying
extraits.texte: I've been using the Hypochlorous Acid Gel in conjunction with the spray & have found the two products to be very effective at reducing redness & healing my breakout spots quickly. I have some stubborn acne around my mouth & chin, & those areas have shown some improvement after just a few days of using the products. The only thing I noticed is that the areas where my breakouts were healing have been getting a bit dry which can make applying makeup a little difficult. I anticipate that my skin just needs a little more time to adjust to the formula, & then the dryness will subside. The photos show a difference in my skin after just a few days of using the spray morning & night & using the gel at night after cleansing. I definitely plan to repurchase this!
